question: Do independent preservation systems offer dated evidence that Coin Metrics BTC historical MVRV CSV content was publicly present in 2020-2025, beyond original Git commit author/committer dates?
testRules: Pin existing R2 source reports by SHA; verify unchanged 684 Sundays, prior c8 strict independent GitHub fork witness count 11, and c9 26 source dates.

Request Software Heritage origin visit metadata using documented read-only public API. For each visit preserve recorded visit timestamp, status, snapshot identifier if provided. Do not confuse a visit event, a snapshot ID or repository commit author timestamp with proof of a particular file value.
Request Internet Archive CDX metadata for three frozen source URL patterns in 2019-2025 and record original URL, capture timestamp, HTTP status, digest when returned.

Two routes have independent network and robots/rate/access failures. Record HTTP errors, malformed responses, empty results as distinct negative source-availability observations, not as claim that historical data never existed.

Only if a capture/visit is temporally before the target Sunday may it be listed as candidate independent historical hosting evidence; the file value is still NOT verified until actual captured CSV bytes and their Git SHA or archived file content hash are linked.
Do not upgrade number of strictly validated original provider first-seen dates or the 11 previously validated public fork witness dates based on timestamp metadata alone.
Never fetch paid services or secrets, change metrics, adopt free-float MVRV, scrape massive external content, leak full proprietary/restricted data or assume temporal continuity across samples.
No trading signals, no optimization, no price-outcome models, no recomputation of the 684-week panel, no Coin Metrics dataset raw CSV redistribution.

gradedProvenance.tier_A: independent dated capture with verifiable pinned numerical file bytes proven to precede decision (not yet obtained by metadata-only test)
gradedProvenance.tier_B: independent third-party archive visit/capture date and URL, but no verified exact file content
gradedProvenance.tier_C: original repo Git metadata or modern retrospective reconstructed CSV only

output: GitHub Actions JSON with granular source responses, R2 upload and SHA256 read-back; no hypothesis success inferred from mere HTTP availability.
